name: ColorSort-Rack Experiment
description: Demonstration protocol for component identification, pickup, transfer, and placement on payload rack.

steps.name: Prepare Workspace
steps.description: Position yourself in front of the payload rack and ensure workspace is clear.
steps.recovery_instruction: Return hands to neutral posture and face the camera/rack.

steps.name: Identify Component
steps.description: Locate designated component (colored block) in the source tray.
steps.recovery_instruction: Look toward the source tray on the left side of the rack.

steps.name: Reach for Component
steps.description: Extend hand toward the identified component.
steps.recovery_instruction: Reach your primary hand toward the target component in tray.

steps.name: Pick Up Component
steps.description: Grasp the component securely with hand.
steps.recovery_instruction: Firmly grasp the component before moving it.

steps.name: Move Component
steps.description: Transfer component toward the designated target slot on rack.
steps.recovery_instruction: Steadily move the component toward the target rack slot.

steps.name: Place Component
steps.description: Insert/place component inside the target slot on rack.
steps.recovery_instruction: Ensure the component is positioned inside slot before releasing.

steps.name: Verify Placement
steps.description: Check that component is correctly aligned and locked.
steps.recovery_instruction: Inspect alignment of placed component on rack.

steps.name: Return to Neutral
steps.description: Withdraw hands back to neutral position away from rack.

steps.name: Complete Experiment
steps.recovery_instruction: Experiment cycle is finished. You may stop session.
